title: Connection-string password: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: Synthetic Connection-string password values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in command lines, environment files, log lines, source code, and structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML). Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: The password is the inner span; the whole URI is the authored envelope, so a whole-URI finding is covered with measured collateral instead of a footnote.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (provider documentation); claim not itemised.

incidents.summary: connection-string misses the password in dialect+driver:// URLs (postgresql+psycopg://)

externalRefs.note: Product issue where the failure mode was reported; product workflow status is not imported.
Legacy benchmark issue the suite slice was written for.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Beta.11 independent family evidence for fifteen selected credential families (#379)" (beta8-379); not yet reviewed.
